targets.summary: The new Muon momentum-buffer aliasing test should be moved into TestOptimRenewed and use its device/dtype parametrization (@dtypes float32/bfloat16, nesterov parametrize).
targets.maintainer_comment:
move the test to TestOptimRenewed, delete the long unreadable comment: 

```
      @dtypes(torch.float32, torch.bfloat16)
      @parametrize("nesterov", [False, True])
      def test_muon_orthogonalization_does_not_alias_momentum_buffer(self, device, dtype, nesterov):
          momentum = 0.9
          param = Parameter(torch.zeros(8, 5, device=device, dtype=dtype))
          param.grad = torch.ones_like(param)
          optimizer = torch.optim.Muon(
              [param],
              lr=0,
              weight_decay=0,
              momentum=momentum,
              nesterov=nesterov,
          )
          expected = torch.zeros_like(param)
          expected.lerp_(param.grad, 1 - momentum)
          optimizer.step()
          self.assertEqual(
              optimizer.state[param]["momentum_buffer"],
              expected,
          )
```
targets.human_label: yes: should be captured as a blocking issue
